surface: Users API GET /api/v1/users (+ GET /api/v1/users/{userId}/groups for group-derived access)
auth_scope: okta.users.read + okta.groups.read (read-only OAuth 2.0 scopes; no lifecycle or write scopes granted)

pagination.exhaustion_method: follow the after cursor from the Link rel="next" header until the header is absent; limit=200

rate_limits: /api/v1/users org-tier rate-limit bucket; honor X-Rate-Limit-Remaining and X-Rate-Limit-Reset headers
history_caveats: STATE only: statusChanged carries the most recent lifecycle transition timestamp, not the transition history - TIMING assertions need the System Log

source_citations.title: Okta Groups API reference (user group memberships)
